test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A bronze article having a marked price of Rs. 1,000 is sold during a festive season sale after three successive discounts of 20% and 30% and 10%. What will be the amount (in Rs.) to be paid by a customer if she buys the article during the festival season?
solution:
Given:

Marked Price = Rs. 1000

Three discounts = 20%, 10% and 30%

Formula used:

SP = MP × [(100 - Discount%)/100]

Calculation:

SP after 1st discount = Rs. 1000 × [80/100]

⇒ Rs. 800

SP after 2nd discount = Rs. 800 × [90/100]

⇒ Rs. 720

SP after 3nd discount= Rs. Rs. 720 × [70/100]

⇒ Rs. 504

∴ The required selling price is Rs. 504
